messages.subject: eliminating legend in barplot
parts:
Hi

I tried to eliminate an legend in an barplot but it does not work. Can somebody
help me?

here is the R-code and besides a pdf-file of my final aim is attached:

relH <- as.numeric(c(0.0193, 0.0934, 0.1691, 0.1014, 0.0612, 0.0386, 0.1562,
0.1578,
          0.1256, 0.0772, 0.0579, 0.2496, 0.3269, 0.2270, 0.1384))
hypK <- c(rep("CH", 5), rep("EU",5), rep("Tot", 5))
inc <- c(rep(c("<3000","3000-5000","5000-7000","7000-9000",">9000"),3))
dat <- as.data.frame(cbind(inc, hypK))
dat.eink <- cbind(dat, relH)
colnames(dat.eink) <- c("Einkommenskategorien", "hypo_Einkauf",
"rel_Häufigkeit")

## Barplot of the income
e <- ggplot(dat.eink, aes(x=Einkommenskategorien, y=rel_Häufigkeit,
                            colour=hypo_Einkauf, fill=hypo_Einkauf))
e <- e + geom_bar(position="dodge", alpha=0.8)
e <- e + geom_hline(y=0, colour="grey40")
e <- e + scale_fill_manual("hypothetischer \nEinkauf",
                                      value = c("CH-Kauf"="darkorange",
                                              "EU-Kauf"="steelblue2",
                                              "Total"="olivedrab2"))
e <- e + scale_colour_manual("hypothetischer \nEinkauf",
                                            value = c("CH-Kauf"="orange3",
                                                 "EU-Kauf"="steelblue3",
                                                 "Total"="olivedrab3"))
e <- e + scale_y_continuous("rel. Häufigkeit", limits = c(0.0, 0.35))
e <- e + scale_x_discrete("Einkommenskategorien (CHF/Mt.)")
e <- e + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=10, vjust=1, colour="grey40"))
e <- e + opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size=12, vjust=-0.5, hjust=0.56,
                                        colour="black"))
e <- e + opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=10, hjust=1, colour="grey40"))
e <- e + opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size=12, hjust=0,
                                        colour="black", angle=90))
e <- e + opts(title = "Einkommensverteilung")
e <- e + opts(plot.title = theme_text(size=14, vjust=1.5, hjust=0.55))
e <- e + opts(panel.background = theme_rect(colour="black", fill="grey85"))
## would like to eliminate the entire legend!!!!! but does not work
e <- e + opts(legend.text = theme_blank())
e <- e + opts(legend.title = theme_blank())
e <- e + opts(legend.key = theme_blank())
e <- e + opts(legend.background = theme_blank())
e 

Thank you very much
Conradin

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: eliminating legend in barplot
parts:
Conradin,

Your plot call does not work because in your scale_*_manual calls you have used the wrong names. Your data says CH, EU, Tot and you had CH-kauf (etc...). After fixing that, if you add legend = F to your scale_*_manual calls it produces a graph without a legend. 

ggplot(dat.eink, aes(x=Einkommenskategorien, y=rel_Häufigkeit,
                            colour=hypo_Einkauf, fill=hypo_Einkauf))+
geom_bar(position="dodge", alpha=0.8)+
geom_hline(y=0, colour="grey40")+
scale_fill_manual("hypothetischer \nEinkauf",
                                      value = c("CH"="darkorange",
                                              "EU"="steelblue2",
                                              "Tot"="olivedrab2"), legend=F)+
scale_colour_manual("hypothetischer \nEinkauf",
                                            value = c("CH"="orange3",
                                                 "EU"="steelblue3",
                                                 "Tot"="olivedrab3"), legend=F)

HTH.

Brandon

P.S. normally the legend=F would work in the geom_bar() call, but since you're defining your scales manually you need it in each of your manual calls.
